definitions.entity_cost: Every query-centroid and query-prototype dot product, including leaves, costs one. Offline indexing excluded and timed separately.
definitions.claim_cost: Each new question-claim dot product costs one; already-paid claim leaf scores reused and logged. Graph enumeration excluded.
definitions.flat: Exhaustive same BGE leaf scorer is primary reference; seeded query-independent scan is secondary equal-budget reference.
definitions.precision: Output-node fraction matching expected names; extended adds valid_but_unlisted. Empty output precision=0; unmapped recall=null.
definitions.recall: Macro question recall over mapped named targets; identical-surface mentions share a target. Claim recall only conservative automated alignments.
definitions.cutoff: 2025 primary; 2026 annual sensitivity may include post-February material.
definitions.label: Paired legacy/improved gloss NLI on fixed held-out chunks; generation-only independence. Original historical NLI retained separately.
